description: Fixtures for npm run eval:grading: 8 answers with known Vietnamese-learner errors (expected_codes), 2 correct translations that differ from the reference (must get zero errors and meaning_ok true), and 2 writing samples (one weak, one strong) and 1 off-topic writing sample (expected_on_topic false: its CEFR must not count). Phase 11: 2 texts with a repeated code plus others (expected_shown_codes: the 3 errors shown must cover the distinct codes, e.g. COP is not crowded out by a second SVA).

items.prompt_vi: Viết email cho sếp để xin nghỉ hai ngày vào tuần sau. Giải thích lý do và cách bạn sắp xếp công việc khi vắng mặt.
items.user_text:
Dear Ms Hoa,

I am writing to ask for two days of leave next Thursday and Friday. My grandmother is having an operation in Hue, and my family would like me to be with her while she recovers.

Before I leave, I will finish the monthly sales report and send it to you on Wednesday afternoon. Minh has kindly agreed to answer my clients' emails, and I have already shown him where the contract files are. If anything urgent comes up, I will check my messages every evening and reply as soon as I can.

Thank you for considering my request. Please let me know if you need any more information.

Best regards,
Lan
items.note: Strong sample: expect B2 or above and few or no errors.
